decisions.subject: Scope and authorship
decisions.decision: Only methods/ is writable; author/corrected/common results remain separate; no model winner or team acceptance inferred.

decisions.subject: Shared capture in Nastya direct programs
decisions.decision: Independent program capture lacks a common pair budget; repeat MOW-OMS reproduced on exact 2f03. A fix must constrain the same market during marginal selection.
decisions.limit: Real saved repeats do not exceed the entire supplied annual market; whole corrected network NOT_RUN here.

decisions.subject: Aggregate capture implementation
decisions.decision: Test author capture at total unique frequency, then allocate under dated seat and shared market caps. Compare proportional and contribution-priority allocation where relevant.
decisions.limit: One defensible scenario, not calibrated demand and not uniquely mandated by the defect.

decisions.subject: Primary common period
decisions.decision: Use 2026-12-07/2026-12-13 as the first dated unit experiment; preserve separate annual/seasonal budgets.
decisions.limit: Winter week is not annual or future 2027-2028 forecast.

decisions.subject: Route definition for case compliance
options: Author service programs with explicit physical pairs alongside
decisions.evidence: Eight Nastya triangles produce 20/18 physical pairs in base/cautious; Tsiri eight-ray network has eight pairs.
decisions.proposal: Use physical pairs for common reporting and retain author program_count; confirm exact case interpretation.

decisions.subject: Screening radius and node scope
options: No hard radius with actual market overlap analysis
Strict new node versus development of existing support
decisions.limit: No default changed in dashboard; radius does not estimate own cannibalization.

decisions.subject: Weights and UNKNOWN
decisions.decision: Keep Nastya and Tsiri author profiles and the hypothesis queue separate. No new weight is TEAM_ACCEPTED.
decisions.basis: User contract; screening pending independent review

decisions.subject: Future fleet envelopes
decisions.decision: Run resource envelopes 4+1 and 9+1 from the author assumptions as conditional limits; future N and arrival date are parameters.
decisions.limit: Not a claim that Red Wings will receive these counts or that all ceiling capacity must be used.

decisions.subject: No-kover baseline and other risk
decisions.decision: Preserve no-kover baseline; financial overlay separate; removing kover does not remove weather, technical or sanctions-related constraints.
decisions.limit: No forecast end date, no probability from publication-day counts.

decisions.subject: Full budget definition
decisions.decision: Separate contribution, full accrual result and cash funding peak; retain unknown base/fleet/startup/working-capital/exit items as NULL or thresholds.
decisions.limit: Working capital is not a second operating expense.

decisions.subject: Donor and own migration
decisions.decision: Compare KEEP, CANCEL_WITHOUT_REPLACEMENT and REPLACE states; subtract donor contribution only once. Do not also deduct its revenue or its alternative margin if already in baseline.
decisions.limit: No donor selected, OMS/REN not declared weak.

decisions.subject: Mixed network
decisions.decision: Pool endpoint OD across direct and transfer products; keep itinerary-specific fare/quality/legs. Do not infer product type from the first itinerary in an OD list.
decisions.basis: Pinned RouteModel.evaluate and Model.itineraries; separate-network source use need not violate conservation.

decisions.subject: Research queue
decisions.decision: Keep 35 hypotheses and useful new evidence in parallel queue with influence and refusal tests; integration does not delete or downgrade them.

decisions.subject: Objective and risk tolerance
options: Full-budget nonnegative outcome plus case passenger/share requirement
Explicit strategic support budget with quantified passenger benefit
Defer program while testing demand/resource conditions
decisions.limit: An agent cannot assign company risk appetite or approved loss budget.

decisions.subject: Tsiri next test
decisions.decision: Check one real donor replacement to SVX-MRV; retain UFA hub as conditional alternative.
decisions.limit: Not team choice, not a computed replacement, not authorization to fly.

decisions.subject: Acceptance and review
decisions.decision: Keep AUTHOR_REPLAY_MATCHED distinct from export arithmetic; this package has only listed scoped checks until independent review and full replay arrive.
